MLPerf EDU currently registers **30 workloads** in **23 families** across **10 suites**. Every page in this section is generated from the [workload registry](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/blob/main/mlperf-edu/registry); the registry YAML is the single source of truth for models, datasets, quality targets, and public-result status.

## Agent Systems (`agent`)

Agentic workloads that measure retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, ReAct-style reasoning loops, and code generation as systems benchmarks rather than capability evaluations.

| [`nano-rag-agent`](../benchmarks/agent/nano-rag-agent.qmd) | agent | nano-rag-agent | 20.1M | react_traces | — | systems-only |
| [`nano-react-agent`](../benchmarks/agent/nano-react-agent.qmd) | agent | nano-react-agent | 13.7M | react_traces | — | systems-only |
| [`nano-toolcall-agent`](../benchmarks/agent/nano-toolcall-agent.qmd) | agent | nano-toolcall-agent | 13.7M | react_traces | — | systems-only |

## Distributed Training (`distributed`)

Local multi-process workloads that expose distributed data-parallel behavior (gradient synchronization, communication/computation overlap) without requiring a cluster.

| **Workload** | **Suite** | **Model** | **Params** | **Dataset** | **Variants** | **Public status** |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [`micro-dlrm-distributed`](../benchmarks/distributed/micro-dlrm-distributed.qmd) | distributed | micro-dlrm-1m via torch.distributed (Gloo, 2 ranks, localhost) | 1.0M |  | — | systems-only |
